title: Advancements in TEM Acquisition and Analysis Automation for Large Area Cell and Tissue Imaging and Nanoparticle Characterization
content: While crisp, high-resolution 120kV TEM imaging is critical for accurate ultrastructural analyses of thin section cells and tissues, the capability to efficiently and reproducibly acquire sizeable datasets by a broad range of users is just as essential to effectively support life science and clinical research. In this session, we will present software developments that specifically address automation and ease of use along with the addition of AI-assisted training algorithms for data analysis.
